name: Hara Ryouko
source:
The beautiful sole employee of the café Love & Peace. Although Ruka finds her very attractive, he is hardly the only one; half the police force seems to be after her.

Given how many police officers she chats with in the course of her work, she is surprisingly well-informed about internal NPA affairs.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819160]Steam[/url]]
